datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: Since there are few publicly available landslide datasets and their quality is uneven, to have a good experimental basis, we selected the Bijie dataset published by Ji et al. (2020) [24].

datasets.name: VOC data set
datasets.verbatim: In the experiment, we set and adjusted the training parameters uniformly for all the models, as shown in Table 4... datasets used for pre-training VOC data set

methods.name: PSPNet with ResNet50 backbone
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation model that uses a pyramid pooling module to capture multiscale context information, with ResNet50 as the backbone network for feature extraction, trained to perform pixel-level landslide identification.
methods.verbatim: According to the experimental results, the best recognition accuracy of PSPNet is with the classification network ResNet50 as the backbone network.

reproducibility_assessment: The Bijie landslide dataset is referenced but not linked, and the VOC dataset is mentioned without a link. The custom PSPNet code is mentioned but lacks a repository or persistent link.
